verdict.root_cause: After the button was clicked, the app sent the deduplication request without the content format the server requires. The server rejected it, and the page then tried to read the error page as successful result data.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent used the requested button on the correct page. The evidence shows that click triggered the intended /api/run-dedupe request; the failure occurred because the product request was rejected with HTTP 415, not because the agent selected a wrong control or proceeded too early.
